title: On Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
authors_zh: Fawaz Sammani、Tzoulio Chamiti、Nikos Deligiannis（机构：布鲁塞尔自由大学、imec）
paper_type_zh: 多模态测试时扩展基准与分析
best_for_zh: 需要在视觉语言模型尺寸与推理策略之间分配推理预算的读者。
one_line: A broad LVLM study finds that standard test-time scaling can strongly help capable small models but can hurt perception tasks when extra reasoning makes models lose visual focus.
这项大规模视觉语言模型研究发现，标准测试时扩展能显著帮助有能力的小模型，但额外推理也可能使模型失去视觉焦点并损害感知任务。
why: It extends test-time scaling evaluation beyond text-only reasoning and identifies when extra computation improves visual reasoning versus induces overthinking.
inclusion_reason: It directly tests how additional inference-time reasoning, sampling, and refinement computation changes accuracy and runtime for vision-language models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Text-only test-time scaling does not automatically transfer to models that must preserve information from an image while producing a long reasoning chain. Prior work has reported mixed or negative results for small vision-language models, leaving it unclear whether more prompting, sampling, aggregation, or refinement is useful, which model scales benefit, and whether the gain survives beyond a single visual benchmark.

The paper asks whether standard language-model scaling strategies work directly for vision-language models without changing weights. It also asks when more inference becomes harmful. A useful answer must compare accuracy and runtime across reasoning and perception tasks, because a method that improves mathematical visual reasoning but encourages unsupported visual assumptions is not a generally safe compute-allocation policy.

只针对文本的测试时扩展不会自动迁移到必须在生成长推理链时保留图像信息的模型。既有工作在小型视觉语言模型上报告了不一致甚至负面的结果，因此尚不清楚额外提示、采样、聚合或反思是否有用，哪些模型尺寸会受益，以及收益能否超越单一视觉基准。

论文研究标准语言模型扩展策略能否在不改变权重的条件下直接用于视觉语言模型，并进一步询问何时更多推理会造成伤害。一个有用答案必须同时比较推理与感知任务上的准确率和运行时间，因为若某方法改善视觉数学推理却诱发缺乏依据的视觉假设，它就不是通用安全的计算分配策略。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The work evaluates a common family of training-free scaling operations instead of proposing a new model. Single-pass methods ask for a chain of thought, structured decomposition, planning, image description, or a scene graph. Multi-pass methods sample several chains and vote or aggregate them, or sequentially refine a previous chain. This permits an apples-to-apples comparison of what kind of additional computation is spent before an LVLM emits its final answer.

The central finding is conditional rather than universal. Capable small LVLMs often gain the most from test-time scaling and can match or surpass a much larger baseline at a suitable budget. But extra reasoning can make a model overthink perception tasks. Attention analysis suggests that visual information is incorporated early in the chain, after which later text is increasingly driven by an internal representation rather than fresh visual grounding.

该工作并未提出新模型，而是评测一组共同的免训练扩展操作。单次方法要求模型给出思维链、结构化分解、规划、图像描述或场景图；多次方法采样多条链后投票或聚合，或对先前链条顺序反思。这使人们能够公平比较视觉语言模型在输出最终答案前，额外计算具体花在何种行为上。

核心发现是有条件的，而非普遍性的。能力较强的小型视觉语言模型通常从测试时扩展中获益最多，并能在合适预算下达到或超过大得多的基线模型。但额外推理可能使模型在感知任务中过度思考。注意力分析表明，视觉信息在思维链早期被吸收，之后的文本越来越依赖内部表示，而非持续的新鲜视觉依据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evaluation spans thirteen instruction-tuned models: Qwen2.5-VL from 7B to 72B, Qwen3-VL from 2B to 32B, InternVL3.5 from 2B to 38B, and Molmo2 at 4B and 8B. It uses six benchmarks covering general multimodal ability, spatial perception, hallucination, visual mathematics, logic, and visual question answering. Generations are capped at 1,024 tokens, and runtime is measured on H200 GPUs rather than inferred only from token counts.

For each model and task, the authors compare the unscaled baseline with nine inference policies: CoT, structured CoT, plan-and-solve, self-consistency, self-aggregation, self-refinement, describe-answer, compositional CoT, and prompt repetition. They report benchmark accuracy and average runtime, construct accuracy-compute frontiers for selected model pairs, and analyze both attention to image tokens and the sufficiency of reasoning chains through LLM judging and human evaluation.

评测覆盖十三个指令微调模型：7B 到 72B 的 Qwen2.5-VL、2B 到 32B 的 Qwen3-VL、2B 到 38B 的 InternVL3.5，以及 4B 和 8B 的 Molmo2。它使用六个基准，涵盖通用多模态能力、空间感知、幻觉、视觉数学、逻辑和视觉问答。生成长度上限为 1,024 词元，运行时间在 H200 GPU 上实测，而非只从词元数推断。

对每个模型和任务，作者比较未扩展基线与九种推理策略：思维链、结构化思维链、计划—执行、自一致性、自聚合、自我反思、描述—作答、组合思维链和提示重复。他们报告基准准确率与平均运行时间，为选定模型对构造准确率—计算前沿，并通过对图像词元的注意力分析、语言模型评判和人工评估研究推理链的信息充分性。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reported Qwen results show large gains for capable small models. On WeMath, Qwen3-VL-2B rises from 35.46 without scaling to 64.25 with self-consistency, while its average runtime rises from 0.1 to 40.2 seconds. Qwen3-VL-4B with self-consistency reaches 74.25 on WeMath and 62.95 on LogicVista; at about a nine-second budget, the paper reports that the 4B model can match the 32B baseline on HallusionBench and outperform it on LogicVista and WeMath.

The evidence also bounds the claim. On RealWorldQA, several reasoning-heavy methods reduce accuracy for some Qwen sizes, and self-refinement is especially unstable on certain Qwen2.5-VL settings. Across the study, simple CoT is identified as the strongest general runtime-performance compromise. The authors connect these patterns to attention behavior: as chains become verbose, attention to image tokens declines after an early visual-encoding window, increasing the risk of unsupported text-only reasoning.

报告的 Qwen 结果显示，能力较强的小模型有很大收益。在 WeMath 上，Qwen3-VL-2B 从未扩展时的 35.46 提升到自一致性的 64.25，但平均运行时间也从 0.1 秒升至 40.2 秒。Qwen3-VL-4B 使用自一致性后在 WeMath 达到 74.25、在 LogicVista 达到 62.95；论文报告，在约九秒预算下，4B 模型能在 HallusionBench 匹配 32B 基线，并在 LogicVista 和 WeMath 超过它。

证据也限定了该主张。在 RealWorldQA 上，多种重推理方法会降低部分 Qwen 尺寸的准确率，而自我反思在某些 Qwen2.5-VL 设置中尤其不稳定。整体上，作者认为简单思维链提供最强的通用运行时间—性能折中。他们把这些模式与注意力行为联系起来：当链条变冗长时，图像词元注意力会在早期视觉编码窗口后下降，从而增加缺乏依据的纯文本推理风险。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's contribution is a broad transfer test for test-time scaling, not a new multimodal reasoning prompt. It places language-model methods and VLM-specific baselines in the same evaluation over model scales, task types, and measured runtime. That comparison overturns a simple extrapolation from small text-only models: a small but capable LVLM may benefit sharply from extra inference even when earlier work suggested small language models would not.

Its other contribution is to treat visual grounding as part of the compute-allocation decision. A method is not successful just because it produces a longer chain or a higher reasoning score; it must preserve the image evidence needed for the task. The paper does not establish that attention is a causal verifier of grounding, but the attention and chain-quality analyses offer a concrete explanation for why a larger budget can improve logical visual tasks while harming straightforward perception.

论文的贡献是对测试时扩展进行广泛迁移测试，而不是提出新的多模态推理提示。它在同一评测中比较语言模型方法和视觉语言模型专用基线，覆盖模型尺寸、任务类型和实测运行时间。这种比较推翻了从小型纯文本模型得出的简单外推：即使早先研究认为小语言模型不会受益，能力较强的小视觉语言模型仍可能从额外推理中显著获益。

另一贡献是把视觉落地视为计算分配决定的一部分。某方法不应只因产生更长链条或更高推理分数就被视为成功；它还必须保留任务所需的图像证据。论文没有证明注意力是视觉落地的因果验证器，但注意力和链质量分析为解释更大预算为何能改善逻辑视觉任务、却伤害直接感知提供了具体线索。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study evaluates public models and benchmarks at a fixed maximum generation length and on one hardware setup, so its Pareto conclusions need not transfer to proprietary models, video tasks, interactive agents, or different latency targets. It reports no official code release, which makes exact prompt and sampling reproduction depend on the paper and supplement. Attention decay is descriptive evidence rather than a proof that later reasoning has lost visual grounding, and benchmark accuracy cannot fully measure hallucination or real-world safety.
研究在固定最大生成长度和一种硬件设置下评测公开模型与基准，因此其帕累托结论未必能迁移到私有模型、视频任务、交互式智能体或不同延迟目标。论文没有报告官方代码发布，使精确提示和采样复现依赖论文及补充材料。注意力衰减是描述性证据，而非后续推理已经失去视觉落地的证明；基准准确率也无法完整衡量幻觉或现实安全性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the result to build a modality-aware router rather than applying one reasoning budget to every image question. For visual mathematics or logic, compare a capable small model with CoT or self-consistency against a larger single-pass model. For spatial and direct-perception tasks, keep a low-budget baseline and reject a longer chain unless it improves a validation set. Logging answer changes across increasing budgets is especially useful for identifying the point where an LVLM begins to overthink.
应利用该结果构建考虑模态的路由器，而不是为所有图像问题施加同一推理预算。对视觉数学或逻辑，可比较使用思维链或自一致性的能力较强小模型与更大但单次推理的模型。对空间和直接感知任务，应保留低预算基线，并且只有在验证集上改善时才接受更长链条。记录答案随预算增加而发生的变化，尤其有助于识别视觉语言模型开始过度思考的临界点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the runtime column with the accuracy columns. The strongest apparent gain, self-consistency on a small model, can require hundreds of times the baseline latency, so it is a scaling result rather than a free replacement for a larger model. The paper is most valuable for its negative cases: RealWorldQA and the attention analysis warn that a generic reasoning prompt can turn a visually simple question into an unsupported text-completion problem.
应把运行时间列与准确率列一起阅读。最显著的表面收益，即小模型上的自一致性，可能需要基线数百倍的延迟，因此它是扩展结果而不是对大模型的免费替代。论文对负面案例尤其有价值：RealWorldQA 和注意力分析警告，通用推理提示可能把视觉上简单的问题变成缺乏依据的文本续写问题。
